verses.original: Λέγω οὖν μὴ ἀπώσατο ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ μὴ γένοιτο καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ Ἰσραηλίτης εἰμί ἐκ σπέρματος Ἀβραάμ φυλῆς Βενιαμίν
verses.transliteration: Legō oun mē apōsato ho Theos ton laon autou mē genoito kai gar egō Israēlitēs eimi ek spermatos Abraam phylēs Beniamin
verses.literal: I ask then did God reject His people Certainly not I am an Israelite myself a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Digo, pois: porventura, rejeitou Deus ao seu povo? De modo nenhum! Porque eu também sou israelita, da descendência de Abraão, da tribo de Benjamim.

verses.original: οὐκ ἀπώσατο ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ὃν προέγνω ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ἐν Ἠλίᾳ τί λέγει ἡ γραφή ὡς ἐντυγχάνει τῷ Θεῷ κατὰ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: ouk apōsato ho Theos ton laon autou hon proegnō ē ouk oidate en Ēlia ti legei hē graphē hōs entynchanei tō Theō kata tou Israēl
verses.literal: God did not reject His people whom He foreknew Do you not know what the Scripture says about Elijah how he appealed to God against Israel
verses.literalPt: Deus não rejeitou ao seu povo, que ele, antes, conheceu. Não sabeis o que a Escritura diz de Elias, como ele insta com Deus contra Israel?

verses.original: Κύριε τοὺς προφήτας σου ἀπέκτειναν τὰ θυσιαστήριά σου κατέσκαψαν κἀγὼ ὑπελείφθην μόνος καὶ ζητοῦσιν τὴν ψυχήν μου
verses.transliteration: Kyrie tous prophētas sou apekteinan ta thysiastēria sou kateskapsan kagō hypeleiphthēn monos kai zētousin tēn psychēn mou
verses.literal: Lord they have killed Your prophets and torn down Your altars I am the only one left and they are seeking my life as well
verses.literalPt: Senhor, mataram os teus profetas, derrubaram os teus altares, e eu fiquei só, e procuram tirar-me a vida.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ τί λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ χρηματισμός Κατέλιπον ἐμαυτῷ ἑπτακισχιλίους ἄνδρας οἵτινες οὐκ ἔκαμψαν γόνυ τῇ Βάαλ
verses.transliteration: Alla ti legei autō ho chrēmatismos Katelipon emautō heptakischilious andras hoitines ouk ekampsan gony tē Baal
verses.literal: And what was the divine reply . . . to him I have reserved for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal
verses.literalPt: Mas que lhe disse a resposta divina? Eu tenho reservado para mim sete mil homens, os quais não dobraram o joelho a Baal.

verses.original: Οὕτως οὖν καὶ ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ λεῖμμα κατ’ ἐκλογὴν χάριτος γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: Houtōs oun kai en tō nyn kairō leimma kat’ eklogēn charitos gegonen
verses.literal: In the same way . . . . . . at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace
verses.literalPt: Do mesmo modo, pois, ainda no tempo presente, há um resto segundo a eleição da graça.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ χάριτι οὐκέτι ἐξ ἔργων ἐπεὶ ἡ χάρις οὐκέτι γίνεται χάρις
verses.transliteration: ei de chariti ouketi ex ergōn epei hē charis ouketi ginetai charis
verses.literal: And if it is by grace then it is no longer by works Otherwise grace would no longer be grace
verses.literalPt: Mas, se é pela graça, já não é pelas obras; doutra maneira, a graça já não é graça.

verses.original: Τί οὖν ὃ ἐπιζητεῖ Ἰσραήλ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐπέτυχεν ἡ δὲ ἐκλογὴ ἐπέτυχεν οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ ἐπωρώθησαν
verses.transliteration: Ti oun ho epizētei Israēl touto ouk epetychen hē de eklogē epetychen hoi de loipoi epōrōthēsan
verses.literal: What then What Israel was seeking it failed to obtain but the elect did The others were hardened
verses.literalPt: Pois quê? O que Israel busca, isso não tem conseguido, mas a eleição o conseguiu; e os mais foram endurecidos,

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεὸς πνεῦμα κατανύξεως ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν καὶ ὦτα τοῦ μὴ ἀκούειν ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Edōken autois ho Theos pneuma katanyxeōs ophthalmous tou mē blepein kai ōta tou mē akouein heōs tēs sēmeron hēmeras
verses.literal: as it is written God gave them a spirit of stupor eyes that could not see and ears that could not hear to this very day . . .
verses.literalPt: como está escrito: Deu-lhes Deus um espírito de torpor, olhos para não verem e ouvidos para não ouvirem, até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: Καὶ Δαυὶδ λέγει Γενηθήτω ἡ τράπεζα αὐτῶν εἰς παγίδα καὶ εἰς θήραν καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλον καὶ εἰς ἀνταπόδομα αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai Dauid legei Genēthētō hē trapeza autōn eis pagida kai eis thēran kai eis skandalon kai eis antapodoma autois
verses.literal: And David says May their table become . . . a snare and a trap - a stumbling block and a retribution to them
verses.literalPt: Davi disse: A sua mesa se lhes torne em laço, em armadilha, em tropeço e em retribuição;

verses.original: σκοτισθήτωσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν καὶ τὸν νῶτον αὐτῶν διὰ παντὸς σύνκαμψον
verses.transliteration: skotisthētōsan hoi ophthalmoi autōn tou mē blepein kai ton nōton autōn dia pantos synkampson
verses.literal: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see and their backs be bent forever
verses.literalPt: os olhos se lhes escureçam, para não verem, e tu encurva-lhes sempre as costas.

verses.original: Λέγω οὖν μὴ ἔπταισαν ἵνα πέσωσιν μὴ γένοιτο ἀλλὰ τῷ αὐτῶν παραπτώματι ἡ σωτηρία τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εἰς τὸ παραζηλῶσαι αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Legō oun mē eptaisan hina pesōsin mē genoito alla tō autōn paraptōmati hē sōtēria tois ethnesin eis to parazēlōsai autous
verses.literal: I ask then did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery Certainly not However because of their trespass salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel jealous . . .
verses.literalPt: Digo, pois: porventura, tropeçaram para que caíssem? De modo nenhum! Mas, pela transgressão deles, veio a salvação aos gentios, para incitá-los à emulação.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ τὸ παράπτωμα αὐτῶν πλοῦτος κόσμου καὶ τὸ ἥττημα αὐτῶν πλοῦτος ἐθνῶν πόσῳ μᾶλλον τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: ei de to paraptōma autōn ploutos kosmou kai to hēttēma autōn ploutos ethnōn posō mallon to plērōma autōn
verses.literal: But if their trespass means riches for the world and their failure means riches for the Gentiles how much greater riches will their fullness bring
verses.literalPt: Ora, se a sua transgressão é a riqueza do mundo, e o seu abatimento, a riqueza dos gentios, quanto mais a sua plenitude.

verses.original: Ὑμῖν δὲ λέγω τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐφ’ ὅσον μὲν οὖν εἰμι ἐγὼ ἐθνῶν ἀπόστολος τὴν διακονίαν μου δοξάζω
verses.transliteration: Hymin de legō tois ethnesin eph’ hoson men oun eimi egō ethnōn apostolos tēn diakonian mou doxazō
verses.literal: I am speaking to you Gentiles Inasmuch . . . . . . . . . as I am the apostle to the Gentiles I magnify my ministry
verses.literalPt: Falo, porém, a vós, que sois gentios. Visto, pois, que eu sou apóstolo dos gentios, glorifico o meu ministério,

verses.original: εἴ πως παραζηλώσω μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ σώσω τινὰς ἐξ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: ei pōs parazēlōsō mou tēn sarka kai sōsō tinas ex autōn
verses.literal: in the hope that . . . I may provoke my own people to jealousy and save some of them
verses.literalPt: para ver se, de algum modo, posso incitar à emulação os da minha raça e salvar alguns deles.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ἡ ἀποβολὴ αὐτῶν καταλλαγὴ κόσμου τίς ἡ πρόσλημψις εἰ μὴ ζωὴ ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: ei gar hē apobolē autōn katallagē kosmou tis hē proslēmpsis ei mē zōē ek nekrōn
verses.literal: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world what will their acceptance be but . . . life from the dead
verses.literalPt: Pois, se a rejeição deles é a reconciliação do mundo, que será a sua admissão, senão a vida dentre os mortos?

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀπαρχὴ ἁγία καὶ τὸ φύραμα καὶ εἰ ἡ ῥίζα ἁγία καὶ οἱ κλάδοι
verses.transliteration: ei de hē aparchē hagia kai to phyrama kai ei hē rhiza hagia kai hoi kladoi
verses.literal: If the first part of the dough is holy so is the whole batch if the root is holy so are the branches
verses.literalPt: Mas, se as primícias são santas, também a massa o é; e, se a raiz é santa, também os ramos o são.

verses.original: Εἰ δέ τινες τῶν κλάδων ἐξεκλάσθησαν σὺ δὲ ἀγριέλαιος ὢν ἐνεκεντρίσθης ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ συνκοινωνὸς τῆς ῥίζης τῆς πιότητος τῆς ἐλαίας ἐγένου
verses.transliteration: Ei de tines tōn kladōn exeklasthēsan sy de agrielaios ōn enekentristhēs en autois kai synkoinōnos tēs rhizēs tēs piotētos tēs elaias egenou
verses.literal: Now if some branches have been broken off and you a wild olive shoot have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root
verses.literalPt: Porém, se alguns dos ramos foram quebrados, e tu, sendo zambujeiro, foste enxertado entre eles e te tornaste participante com eles da raiz e da seiva da oliveira,

verses.original: μὴ κατακαυχῶ τῶν κλάδων εἰ δὲ κατακαυχᾶσαι οὐ σὺ τὴν ῥίζαν βαστάζεις ἀλλὰ ἡ ῥίζα σέ
verses.transliteration: mē katakauchō tōn kladōn ei de katakauchasai ou sy tēn rhizan bastazeis alla hē rhiza se
verses.literal: do not boast over those branches If you do, remember this You do not support the root but the root supports you
verses.literalPt: não te glories contra os ramos; porém, se te gloriares, não és tu o que sustentas a raiz, mas a raiz, a ti.

verses.original: Ἐρεῖς οὖν Ἐξεκλάσθησαν κλάδοι ἵνα ἐγὼ ἐγκεντρισθῶ
verses.transliteration: Ereis oun Exeklasthēsan kladoi hina egō enkentristhō
verses.literal: You will say then Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in
verses.literalPt: Dirás, pois: Alguns ramos foram quebrados, para que eu fosse enxertado.

verses.original: καλῶς τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ ἐξεκλάσθησαν σὺ δὲ τῇ πίστει ἕστηκας μὴ ὑψηλὰ φρόνει ἀλλὰ φοβοῦ
verses.transliteration: kalōs tē apistia exeklasthēsan sy de tē pistei hestēkas mē hypsēla phronei alla phobou
verses.literal: That is correct They were broken off because of unbelief but you stand by faith Do not be arrogant . . . but be afraid
verses.literalPt: Bem! Pela sua incredulidade, foram quebrados, mas tu, pela tua fé, estás firme.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς τῶν κατὰ φύσιν κλάδων οὐκ ἐφείσατο μή πως οὐδὲ σοῦ φείσεται
verses.transliteration: ei gar ho Theos tōn kata physin kladōn ouk epheisato mē pōs oude sou pheisetai
verses.literal: For if God did not spare the natural branches He will certainly not spare you either
verses.literalPt: Não te ensoberbeças, mas teme; porque, se Deus não poupou os ramos naturais, não te poupará a ti.

verses.original: ἴδε οὖν χρηστότητα καὶ ἀποτομίαν Θεοῦ ἐπὶ μὲν τοὺς πεσόντας ἀποτομία ἐπὶ δὲ σὲ χρηστότης Θεοῦ ἐὰν ἐπιμένῃς τῇ χρηστότητι ἐπεὶ καὶ σὺ ἐκκοπήσῃ
verses.transliteration: Ide oun chrēstotēta kai apotomian Theou epi men tous pesontas apotomia epi de se chrēstotēs Theou ean epimenēs tē chrēstotēti epei kai sy ekkopēsē
verses.literal: Take notice therefore of the kindness and severity of God severity to those who fell but kindness to you if you continue in His kindness Otherwise you also will be cut off
verses.literalPt: Notai, pois, a bondade e a severidade de Deus: severidade para com aqueles que caíram, mas bondade de Deus para contigo, se permaneceres nessa bondade; doutra maneira, também tu serás cortado.

verses.original: κἀκεῖνοι δέ ἐὰν μὴ ἐπιμένωσιν τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ ἐνκεντρισθήσονται δυνατὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ Θεὸς πάλιν ἐνκεντρίσαι αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kakeinoi de ean mē epimenōsin tē apistia enkentristhēsontai dynatos gar estin ho Theos palin enkentrisai autous
verses.literal: And if they do not persist in unbelief they will be grafted in for God is able to graft them in again
verses.literalPt: Eles também, se não permanecerem na sua incredulidade, serão enxertados; pois Deus é poderoso para os enxertar de novo.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ σὺ ἐκ τῆς κατὰ φύσιν ἐξεκόπης ἀγριελαίου καὶ παρὰ φύσιν ἐνεκεντρίσθης εἰς καλλιέλαιον πόσῳ μᾶλλον οὗτοι οἱ κατὰ φύσιν ἐνκεντρισθήσονται τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἐλαίᾳ
verses.transliteration: ei gar sy ek tēs kata physin exekopēs agrielaiou kai para physin enekentristhēs eis kallielaion posō mallon houtoi hoi kata physin enkentristhēsontai tē idia elaia
verses.literal: For if you were cut from a wild olive tree and contrary to nature were grafted into one that is cultivated how much more readily will these the natural branches be grafted into their own olive tree
verses.literalPt: Se tu foste cortado do natural zambujeiro e, contra a natureza, foste enxertado em boa oliveira, quanto mais não serão enxertados na sua própria oliveira aqueles que são ramos naturais!

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν ἀδελφοί τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο ἵνα μὴ ἦτε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς φρόνιμοι ὅτι πώρωσις ἀπὸ μέρους τῷ Ἰσραὴλ γέγονεν ἄχρι οὗ τὸ πλήρωμα τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰσέλθῃ
verses.transliteration: Ou gar thelō hymas agnoein adelphoi to mystērion touto hina mē ēte en heautois phronimoi hoti pōrōsis apo merous tō Israēl gegonen achri hou to plērōma tōn ethnōn eiselthē
verses.literal: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery brothers so that you will not be conceited . . . . . . A hardening in part has come to Israel until . . . the full number of the Gentiles has come in
verses.literalPt: Pois não quero, irmãos, que ignoreis este mistério, para que não sejais sábios em vós mesmos: que o endurecimento veio em parte a Israel, até que haja entrado a plenitude dos gentios;

verses.original: καὶ οὕτως πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ σωθήσεται καθὼς γέγραπται Ἥξει ἐκ Σιὼν ὁ Ῥυόμενος ἀποστρέψει ἀσεβείας ἀπὸ Ἰακώβ
verses.transliteration: kai houtōs pas Israēl sōthēsetai kathōs gegraptai Hēxei ek Siōn ho Rhyomenos apostrepsei asebeias apo Iakōb
verses.literal: And so all Israel will be saved as it is written The Deliverer will come from Zion He will remove godlessness from Jacob
verses.literalPt: assim, todo o Israel será salvo, como está escrito: Virá de Sião o Libertador, ele apartará de Jacó a impiedade.

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη αὐτοῖς ἡ παρ’ ἐμοῦ διαθήκη ὅταν ἀφέλωμαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai hautē autois hē par’ emou diathēkē hotan aphelōmai tas hamartias autōn
verses.literal: And this is My covenant with them when I take away their sins
verses.literalPt: Esta é a minha aliança com eles, quando eu tirar os seus pecados.

verses.original: Κατὰ μὲν τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἐχθροὶ δι’ ὑμᾶς κατὰ δὲ τὴν ἐκλογὴν ἀγαπητοὶ διὰ τοὺς πατέρας
verses.transliteration: Kata men to euangelion echthroi di’ hymas kata de tēn eklogēn agapētoi dia tous pateras
verses.literal: Regarding the gospel they are enemies on your account . . . but regarding election they are loved on account of the patriarchs
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao evangelho, eles são inimigos por vossa causa; mas, quanto à eleição, são amados por causa de seus pais;

verses.original: ἀμεταμέλητα γὰρ τὰ χαρίσματα καὶ ἡ κλῆσις τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ametamelēta gar ta charismata kai hē klēsis tou Theou
verses.literal: For God’s gifts and His call are irrevocable
verses.literalPt: porque dos dons e da sua vocação Deus não se arrepende.

verses.original: Ὥσπερ γὰρ ὑμεῖς ποτε ἠπειθήσατε τῷ Θεῷ νῦν δὲ ἠλεήθητε τῇ τούτων ἀπειθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hōsper gar hymeis pote ēpeithēsate tō Theō nyn de ēleēthēte tē toutōn apeitheia
verses.literal: Just as you who formerly disobeyed God have now received mercy through their disobedience
verses.literalPt: Assim como vós, em outro tempo, fostes desobedientes a Deus, mas, agora, haveis alcançado misericórdia pela desobediência deles,

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι νῦν ἠπείθησαν τῷ ὑμετέρῳ ἐλέει ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ νῦν ἐλεηθῶσιν
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai houtoi nyn ēpeithēsan tō hymeterō eleei hina kai autoi nyn eleēthōsin
verses.literal: so they too have now disobeyed in order that they too may now receive mercy through the mercy shown to you
verses.literalPt: assim também estes, agora, foram desobedientes, para que, pela vossa misericórdia, eles, agora, também alcancem misericórdia.

verses.original: συνέκλεισεν γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς τοὺς πάντας εἰς ἀπείθειαν ἵνα τοὺς πάντας ἐλεήσῃ
verses.transliteration: synekleisen gar ho Theos tous pantas eis apeitheian hina tous pantas eleēsē
verses.literal: For God has consigned everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on everyone
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus encerrou a todos na desobediência, para usar com todos de misericórdia.

verses.original: Ὦ βάθος πλούτου καὶ σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως Θεοῦ ὡς ἀνεξεραύνητα τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνεξιχνίαστοι αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ō bathos ploutou kai sophias kai gnōseōs Theou hōs anexeraunēta ta krimata autou kai anexichniastoi hai hodoi autou
verses.literal: O the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God How unsearchable are His judgments and untraceable His ways
verses.literalPt: Ó profundidade das riquezas, da sabedoria e da ciência de Deus! Quão inescrutáveis são os seus juízos, e quão impenetráveis os seus caminhos!

verses.original: Τίς γὰρ ἔγνω νοῦν Κυρίου ἢ τίς σύμβουλος αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο
verses.transliteration: Tis gar egnō noun Kyriou ē tis symboulos autou egeneto
verses.literal: Who has known the mind of the Lord Or who has been His counselor
verses.literalPt: Pois quem conheceu a mente do Senhor? Ou quem se fez o seu conselheiro?

verses.original: Ἢ τίς προέδωκεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀνταποδοθήσεται αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ē tis proedōken autō kai antapodothēsetai autō
verses.literal: Who has first given to God that God should repay him
verses.literalPt: Ou quem lhe deu primeiro, para que lhe seja retribuído?

verses.original: ὅτι ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: hoti ex autou kai di’ autou kai eis auton ta panta autō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas amēn
verses.literal: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things To Him be the glory forever Amen
verses.literalPt: Pois dele, por ele e para ele são todas as coisas. A ele seja dada a glória para sempre. Amém.
